notes: ⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium). The listings page uses dynamic JavaScript to populate content into the empty #buildout container. Static HTML scraping with requests/BeautifulSoup will not work. The page appears to load listing data via AJAX/API after page load. To scrape this site, you'll need: 1) A headless browser (Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer), 2) Wait for the #buildout container to be populated with listing elements, 3) Then extract the listing data. The actual selectors for title, price, location will need to be identified after the JS renders the content. Consider inspecting the Network tab in browser DevTools to see if there's an API endpoint that can be called directly for listing data.
